Portfolio highlight #1 - Hover-to-reveal about page One of my fav features from my new portfolio! Hover over each of the items in my about page to learn a little more about me and see pics. Still working on adapting this for mobile haha.

I won $20,000!! (And a summer of learnings, opportunities, and fun, which is priceless). In May, my team at RBC Amplify was tasked with ideating and building a product to make foreign exchange faster, cheaper, and more transparent using blockchain technology.
